binders: Implicit real parameters bulkModulus and density.
A system object containing two real fields of space and time and their global first-order component equations.
Arbitrary real point coordinates x and t.
conclusions: At every (x,t), w_plus = pressure + density*soundSpeed*velocity satisfies (w_plus)_t + soundSpeed*(w_plus)_x = 0.
At every (x,t), w_minus = pressure - density*soundSpeed*velocity satisfies (w_minus)_t - soundSpeed*(w_minus)_x = 0.
mathematical_definitions: The packaged equations are p_t + bulkModulus*u_x = 0 and u_t + density⁻¹*p_x = 0, with derivative witnesses everywhere.
Transport(q,s,x,t) means q_t and q_x exist at (x,t) and q_t + s*q_x = 0.
translation.proposition_plain_english: Every classical two-field system with positive bulkModulus and density yields two characteristic combinations, pressure ± density*sqrt(bulkModulus/density)*velocity, which satisfy scalar transport equations at speeds +sqrt(bulkModulus/density) and -sqrt(bulkModulus/density), respectively, at every point.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The system object already packages classical derivative existence and the first-order equations everywhere.
The proposition gives two transported combinations but no inverse reconstruction formulas, uniqueness statement, completeness statement, or basis claim.
Positivity of soundSpeed is not an explicit conclusion of this target.
Only pointwise classical transport semantics are encoded.
ambiguities: The one-level dossier omits the body of the system structure, but its projections and constructor type expose the two fields and the global component-equation obligation used here.
